- We are a UK-registered entity (Sunburst Analytics Ltd, UK company number 12345678) and operate primarily in GBP — please confirm if PO can be issued in USD or GBP and whether Redwood requires VAT registration evidence.
- Bank details for payments are on our vendor form (we'll include an ACH/SEPA agreement if needed).

I've attached: W-8BEN-E_Sunburst_signed.pdf and a redacted copy of Tom's passport (GovID_TomLee_redacted.jpg). If you need a notarized certificate of incumbency or board minutes, we can provision that within 48 hours.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Sunburst onboarding: tax doc & signatory evidence for PO

Elena — thanks for sending these through and for the call. A few clarifying asks so we can move Sunburst into the PO queue: 

1) Signatory evidence: the W-8BEN-E is fine but procurement requires proof that Tom has authority to sign on behalf of the entity. The usual acceptable items are:
   - Board resolution or certificate of incumbency naming Tom Lee as authorized signatory, OR
   - Copy of a current power of attorney (POA) that references signatory rights.

2) Entity verification: please confirm the legal registered name (exact spelling/capitalization) and provide the company registration extract (Companies House filing) or VAT registration page so our tax team can reconcile the vendor record.

3) Currency & tax withholding: Redwood typically issues POs in USD but can bill in GBP for international vendors. For UK entities providing services to a US company, we do not automatically withhold US tax if the W-8BEN-E is valid and claims treaty benefits. Our tax team will run the W-8 through the vendor verification process and let us know if any withholding applies.

4) Banking: we require a completed vendor bank form with beneficiary name matching the legal entity on the vendor file. If the account is in a different entity name, please provide an intercompany letter explaining the payment flow.

To speed things up, I've created a DocuSign powerform for the W-8/W-9 and signatory ack if you'd prefer to sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&pfid=98765

If you can send the board resolution (or an incumbency certificate) and the Companies House extract by EOD tomorrow, we should be able to get the vendor record reviewed and tentatively issue a PO the following week. Copied Monica (procurement) and Rishi (tax) to confirm timing.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Tom / Elena — appreciate the fast turnaround and the docs. Quick procurement / tax update and next steps: 

1) Documents received: Board resolution, W-8BEN-E (signed), Companies House extract link — thanks. That satisfies our standard signatory and entity verification requirements. No notarization required at this stage.

2) Outstanding item: tax team's final verification of the W-8BEN-E (Rishi will complete this by Mon 10/04). If Rishi flags any treaty-specific questions, we'll come back with a single follow-up.

3) PO and currency: We can issue an initial PO in GBP to match your billing preference. Please confirm the invoice remit name exactly as you want it to appear on the PO (legal name + VAT number). Once confirmed, I will provision the PO in our system and route for signature. Target PO issuance: Tue 10/05 (pending Rishi's sign-off).

4) Banking: We still need the vendor bank form completed with the beneficiary exact match to the legal name. If you prefer, use the DocuSign link Kimberly shared and we will accept that as the signed vendor bank form.

Next steps (summary):
- Tom: confirm remit name and attach bank form via DocuSign or upload to the Drive folder.
- Rishi: complete tax verification (target Mon).
- Monica/Kimberly: issue PO Tue 10/05 if all checks pass.

If anything slips, I'll escalate to the billing team to avoid payment delays.

Thanks,
